pages.title: Shapeless recipe
pages.label: Combine → one result
pages.text: Friendly Slime + a book. Starts waiting and wears a mustache with a baton.

Right-click to open Companions or Players. The tuner opens ordinary stats and also has a roster button. Companion rows show last-known health, orders, work state, location, and whether the entity is loaded, stored, broken, or removed. Hover a row for its position.

Select a companion, type a tag, and choose Save tag. Gather uses the typed tag, even without a selected row. Tags have at most 24 characters and ignore letter case. A blank tag selects untagged companions.

Gather spends 25 stamina and processes living released companions one at a time, including recorded unloaded chunks and other dimensions. They arrive in safe loaded spaces around the commander and wait. Stored, broken, removed, mounted, and passenger companions are excluded.

One temporary source chunk is kept ticking at a time; unavailable or unsafe destinations are skipped. Each source has a five-second wait limit and commands have a five-second cooldown. Recovery or a restart cancels an unfinished gather. Other traits remain intact.

The primary owner controls shared owners and enemies in Players. Shared owners may manage companions; changing player relationships remains with the primary owner. Records are discovered when companions or stored items load. See $(l:cooperation/ownership)Shared ownership$().
